stages.reference: Create a close material reference for aged cut-stone masonry in a grounded dark-fantasy settlement. The blocks were quarried from ordinary native stone and shaped by hand, leaving subtly uneven faces, softened chisel traces, chipped arrises and compressed mineral texture. Mortar or packed joint material is old, recessed and dirty rather than bright. Repeated weather has rounded exposed edges and created restrained damp staining without destroying the masonry. Avoid perfect modern bricks, castle-wall theatricality, giant cracks, heavy moss or identical repeated stones. Make it disciplined human stonework that has survived generations.
